periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Ran winter after-school programs at three Parks/Rec centers for 190 teens. School-based health center counselors began coping-skills sessions. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Plan summer teen programs at five centers and begin recruiting peer mentors.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Teen participation rose to 245, and summer registration opened at five centers. High school counselors helped us recruit the first peer-mentor candidates. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Unified School District, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Run summer programs at five centers, train the peer-mentor cohort, and add a weekly counselor drop-in group.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Summer teen programs at Parks/Rec ran at five centers with about 310 participants, and a peer-mentor cohort of 24 high schoolers was recruited and trained. School-based health center counselors added a weekly drop-in group. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Unified School District, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Open evening programming at Bayview and North Inlet centers, and add transportation vouchers for teens in Dune Avenue.
